title: Scout Produces A Structured Multi-Suspect Diagnosis
description: L6 detective synthesis: the scout must reconnoiter every suspect file, attach concrete evidence to each, explicitly dismiss the config.py TODO red herring, conclude the true root cause is the precision-omitting stale memo key in cache.py, and propose a fix direction -- all read-only, grounded in actual file reads.
prompt: Produce a structured root-cause diagnosis for the failing integration_test.py (output mismatch) while tests/test_calculator.py passes. Investigate read-only and return a report with: (1) suspects considered (src/calculator.py, src/config.py, src/cache.py) with the concrete evidence you found in each file, (2) which suspects you ruled out and why (explicitly address the config.py 'precision may be wrong' TODO as a red herring), (3) the final root cause naming the exact file and defect, and (4) a fix direction. Do not edit anything.
